title: Optimize / evals review 1:1 prep & follow-ups
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Riley Optimize / evals review (prep)
Date: 2025-02-21 (weekly sync slot)
Attendees: Jamie Park (me), Riley Chen
Goals for this 1:1
- Align on root causes for the +6% regression on help-center-summarize prompt set (seen in last A/B)
- Decide quick mitigation (rollback vs prompt gating vs model variant routing)
- Prioritize follow-ups for next week: eval hygiene, additional prompt tests, canary config

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick status (5m)
   - Recap: last A/B (canary v1 -> v2) showed 6% drop in ROUGE-L-style metric on help-center-summarize; user-facing diffs small but infra flagged regression in quality alerts
   - Which slices hurt most: short FAQs (<=100 tokens), non-English (ES/PT) examples marginal, long articles OK

2) Data/metrics deep-dive (10m)
   - Confirmed: regression concentrated in 3 prompt variants (summarize-short, tl;dr, bullets)
   - Check: did tokenization/temperature/batch config change with v2? Not in serving config, but v2 uses a slightly different prompt template (removed system priming sentence)
   - A/B logs: top error patterns - hallucinated contact links, truncated lists, inconsistent bullet formatting

3) Hypotheses (5m)
   - H1: prompt-template change caused model to prefer more abstractive outputs -> shorter ROUGE overlap
   - H2: v2's decoding fallback to top-k5 due to decoder tweak in model packaging (possible)
   - H3: dataset slice bias: canary traffic has higher ratio of customer-FAQ short docs -> amplifies issue

4) Decide immediate mitigation (5m)
   - Option A: Roll back to v1 for all traffic (safe, but loses v2 perf gains elsewhere)
   - Option B: Route help-center-summarize prompt set to v1 only (targeted, easy to config via routing policy)
   - Option C: Re-introduce system priming in prompt for short-summary templates and re-run canary (fast to test)

5) Action items and owners (5m)
   - Riley: add routing rule to send help-center-summarize to v1 for next 48h (JIRA: JIRA-OPT-1125) — due 2025-02-22
   - Jamie: run focused evals on the three prompt variants with both v1 and v2, include ROUGE-L, BLEU, and a new coherence human-check sample (n=120) — due 2025-02-24
   - Priya: double-check model packaging changes between v1/v2 for decoding knobs (top-k/top-p/temperature) and confirm in PR diff — due 2025-02-21
   - Riley + Jamie: prepare short rolling canary with re-introduced system priming for short prompts and smoke test on staging (internal canary id CAN-207) — due 2025-02-25

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep an eye on cost/perf tradeoffs: v2 had 8% token cost reduction on average; targeted routing preferable to full rollback
- Need to update eval suites to include more short-doc examples and non-en English samples — current eval set underrepresents these slices
- Consider adding automated checks that flag sudden metric deltas for small slices (<5% of traffic) to avoid surprises

Open questions / follow-ups
- Was there any change in tokenizer or input truncation? (ask infra/release)
- Do we have stored seeds + deterministic sampling for the eval harness so runs are reproducible? If not, add seeding
- How many customer incidents would a 6% ROUGE-L drop on help-center-summarize translate to? (ask CS for rough sensitivity)

Quick experiment plan (for next week)
- Experiment 1: Reintroduce system priming for short prompts + run eval (A/B within staging) — metric target: regain >=4% ROUGE-L on short prompts without >1% drop on long-doc suite
- Experiment 2: Try soft decoding change (top-k from 5 -> 20) on v2 for short prompts only — measure hallucination rate on small human sample
- Experiment 3: Expand eval dataset with 300 short-FAQ examples (mix of EN/ES/PT) and validate both variants

Notes for meeting: bring quick dashboard screenshots (last 7 days) for these metrics: ROUGE-L (by prompt type), hallucination count (human flags), token cost delta, route distribution. Add links to CAN-207 and JIRA-OPT-1125 in the meeting doc.

Post-meeting follow-ups (to send after 1:1)
- Short email to CS with note: temporary routing change to v1 for help-center-summarize; monitoring in place; ask for any customer reports in next 48h
- Sync with release team to confirm there was no packaging/decoder tweak rolled out accidentally during v2 deploy

Misc scratchpad (tbd)
- If experiments show re-priming helps -> bake template into prompt-templates service and add a feature flag to toggle per-route
- Add a regression test that runs on each model rollout targeting top 3 prompt sets by traffic

end of notes
